messages:
riley: FYI: we're doing the CI OIDC + Jira OAuth app cutover next Tue 2026-02-10 03:00 UTC. This'll replace PATs in runners and swap the old Jira webhook app for the new OAuth app. Estimated disruption window: 20m.

anita: Is this the same maintenance as the GitHub SSO enforcement? Trying to coordinate notices.

riley: Different but related. OIDC affects runners and automation tokens; SSO is org membership/provisioning. We coordinated dates to avoid overlap.

sam: What concrete actions do repo owners need to take?

riley: Two things: 1) Ensure your repo uses ephemeral runner tokens (we'll flip the runner policy). 2) Migrate any automation that uses PATs to the new 'redwood-ci' GitHub App or to OIDC workflows. There's a repo-level checklist in the runbook: https://go.redwood/runbooks/ci-oidc-jira-cutover

victor: For Jira: does this change the webhooks or the credential storage? We have a handful of legacy connectors that store PATs in the Secrets service.

anita: Jira migration will create a new OAuth app and we'll rotate credentials. Secrets that store old PATs should be rotated to the new OAuth tokens. If you need help, open a ticket and tag ops-oncall.

ci-bot: Reminder: run the pre-check scanner: infra/ci/tools/pat_detector.sh --org redwood-inference --fail-on=high. Output: pat-scan-<team>.txt

sam: Can we run a dry-run so we know what will break?

riley: Yes. We'll do a dry-run on Monday 2026-02-09 14:00 UTC for platform + infra repos. That will flip enforcement in a canary mode (no revoke) and produce a report.

ops-oncall: Rollback plan: if jobs start failing, we re-enable PAT acceptance for 15m while teams fix migrations. We'll also have a hotfix window to re-instate tokens. Detailed steps in runbook 'rollback-steps'.

victor: Are there any external vendor integrations that will be blocked?

anita: We identified 3 vendors that don't support OIDC. We're working with vendor teams to request feature updates; in the meantime, those integrations will be put on an exceptions list and require compensating controls. Please add any others you know to the spreadsheet linked in the runbook.

riley: Communications plan: we'll post a calendar invite to team leads, send an all-eng email 48h prior, and a slack banner 1h before the change. If you own automation, add a contact to the migration tracker.

sam: Does CI billing change? I had a question from Finance about runner token billing tags.

anita: No billing change planned. Tags remain. If your pipelines rely on a specific service account for billing scoping, verify tagging after migration.

ci-bot: Maintenance scheduled: CI/OIDC + Jira OAuth cutover Tue 2026-02-10 03:00 UTC. ETA 20m. Ticket: JIRA-8533

riley: TL;DR: OIDC+Jira OAuth cutover on Feb 10 03:00 UTC, dry-run in canary on Feb 9, run the scanner, update secrets, exceptions via eng-security-exceptions, rollback plan in runbook. Please escalate any blockers by EOD Friday.
